mapper.select: SELECT e.id FROM enterprise e WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM background_job j WHERE j.enterprise_id = e.id AND j.kind = #{kind} AND j.available_at <= #{now} AND (j.status = 'queued' OR (j.status = 'leased' AND j.lease_until <= #{now}))) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM background_job busy WHERE busy.enterprise_id = e.id AND busy.kind IN ('file_scan', 'document_parse') AND busy.status = 'leased' AND busy.lease_until > #{now}) < 2 ORDER BY e.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT id, enterprise_id, owner_user_id, kind, payload_json, attempt_count, max_attempts, lease_version FROM background_job WHERE kind = #{kind} AND available_at <= #{now} AND (status = 'queued' OR (status = 'leased' AND lease_until <= #{now})) AND (#{enterprise} IS NULL OR enterprise_id = #{enterprise}) ORDER BY available_at, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT id FROM background_job WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'leased' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_version = #{leaseVersion} AND lease_until > #{now} FOR UPDATE
